question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.
candidate_answer: The proposal deadline was **September 30, 2022, at 4:30 p.m. Hawaii Standard Time**. The RFP required proposals to be received by then. [Hawaii ERS RFP 2022-04, pp. 6–7](Hawaii_ERS__Private-Equity-RFP-8.25.2022-final.pdf)
